notes.title: BIG demo update
notes.content:
Hi!

For two weeks since the demo dropped, we were watching friends and streamers play our tiny little game, carefully recording the things that we can improve, and working on the new big update!

So here it is, NEW BIG UPDATE OF THE DEMO!!!

[b]What's in the new big update?[/b]
[list]
[*] Anomalies, which feel like mini boss-stages
[*] Now the game displays which upgrades you already bought
[*] More juice and animations
[*] Updated the list of prestige upgrades: removed sad upgrades, added new cool upgrades!
[*] Adjusted the game progression so it should feel more smooth and satisfying
[*] Added several card upgrades: more shards to everyone!
[*] Made descriptions more clear, fixes a lot of UI things, added new sounds
[*] Added support of custom screen resolution, including 3440х1440
[*] Fewer bugs
[/list]

Please note that [b]this upgrade will reset your saved game[/b]. Sorry, such things will happen until the release date, because we're still doing some major changes in the game. Hope it's OK!

We're still can't believe how many people checked out our demo and how many positive responses we had from friends, streamers and people we don't even know!

If you enjoy our little game, please don't hesitate to [b]spread the word[/b] about it. This will REALLY help our team!

Have fun!
-Dima

notes.title: New demo and trailer are out!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472659/84ed95c2483b553329001f7a1b3bcf6b5eed8df0.png[/img]

hi!

our DEMO and TRAILER are out as a part of the Steam Idler Fest!

we're 100% inspired by such titans as gnorp and nodebusters, and we're trying to say something new in the genre!

so here is our take:  a physical simulation with automated bots, upgrades, prestiges and synergies. A chill garden where everything bounces around, with a room for strategic optimizations.

hope you'll enjoy our tiny indie game!

thanks!

- dima
